name: Kiyosu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kiyosu city emblem in light blue and navy: a light blue swirl around a navy ring, with a light blue disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kiyosu, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 July 2005.

features.role: Kiyosu city emblem — a light blue swirl around a navy ring, with a light blue disc
